# TASK-088 — Real Ollama integration

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Gate 7 — administration, governance and infrastructure (2026-09-27)

## Intent

Connect to the real Ollama and test it: window-aware requests, a compact context for small models, structured output, safe cleaning of model answers, an admin connection check and a live check script.

## What it delivers

Checked against the real Ollama 0.33.3 with `gemma2:2b` and `nomic-embed-text`: the check script's proposal applies, embeddings return 768 dimensions, and a job through the containerised worker completes in compact mode (70 s, focus on the named section). `tests/ollama.test.ts` (17), `jobs.test.ts`, `ollama.test.tsx`, stories.
